title: Derived restriction of a strict-local neighbourhood germ
statement: Let f, s, K, n, J, q and the canonical comparison A_i be as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-injective-source-comparison], and Q as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry]. Write ell_i for the canonical source germ leg [def-weil-pbc-canonical-derived-cohomology-germs], m for the derived mate homology map, and T for the target iso [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-mate-projection-data]. For each i, ell_i m T equals A_i c_i followed by the derived cohomology restriction along Q.legs.app i: the inverse-image adjunction unit, derived Leray, and inverse of the inverse-image composition comparison for Q.over i. Here c_i is the canonical representativeSectionsComparison at the stage [lem-weil-pbc-injective-sections-pullback-comparison]. This statement does not identify the derived restriction with termwise restriction or assert acyclicity at the limit.

proof.text: The termwise direct image of the given bounded-below complex of injectives is bounded below and K-injective: the inverse-image left adjoint is exact, so direct image preserves injectives. Use sourceInjectiveDirectImageIso to obtain its specified representative r of Rf_*K.
Apply sourceLocalizedSectionsIso_germ to this representative on S. It factors the canonical source germ leg through cohomology of the actual complex of sections on the neighbourhood.

Apply strictLocalComplexSectionRestriction_mate to identify that base complex restriction followed by the derived mate and target isomorphism with stage sections identification, termwise fibre restriction, and the limit representative sections comparison.

The cone-leg clause of injectiveSections_strictLocal_comparison replaces termwise restriction followed by the limit comparison by the stage comparison followed by derived cohomology restriction. Unfold sourceLocalizedSectionsIso and strictLocalInjectiveSourceIso and reassociate: the localized Hom factors followed by the stage section factors are definitionally the original source isomorphism.

theorem strictLocalInjectiveSourceIso_derivedRestriction {X S : Scheme.{v}}
    (f : X ⟶ S)
    {Ω : Type v} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S)
    (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}))
    (n : ℤ) (Q : StrictLocalNeighbourhoodGeometry f s)
    (J : CochainComplex.Plus (InjectiveObject
      (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})))
    (q : K.obj ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((InjectiveObject.ι _).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J.obj)) :
    ∀ i : SmallModel.{v} (Scheme.strictHenselizationNeighbourhoods s),
        ((strictLocalCohomologySourceLegs s
      ((rightDerivedLowerStarPlus AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).obj K) n).app (op i)) ≫
        ((Sheaf.Γ (Scheme.strictHenselizationScheme s).smallEtaleTopology
        AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}).map
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ n).map
          ((mateEquiv (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} f).derivedPlus
            (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
              (pullback.snd f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))).derivedPlus
            (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (pullbackSquareComparison AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
              (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f
                (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s)).toCommSq).hom))
                |>.natTrans.app K))) ≫
        (strictLocalBaseChangeTargetIso f s K n).hom =
            (strictLocalInjectiveSourceIso f s K n J q i).hom ≫
              representativeSectionsComparison
                ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i) q n ≫
      (Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodDiagram f s).obj i) n).map
        ((Etale.mapDerivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
          (Q.legs.app i)).unit.app
            ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app
        i)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              K.obj)) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} n).map
        ((Etale.rightDerivedLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso
          AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (Q.legs.app i)).hom.app
            ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (Q.legs.app i)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
              ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f
        s).app i)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
                K.obj))) ≫
      (Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (pullback f (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap
        s)) n).map
        ((Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
          (Etale.upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (Q.legs.app i)
        ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i) (pullback.fst f
        (Scheme.strictHenselizationStructuralMap s))
            (Q.over i).symm) ≪≫
          Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso
            (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} ((strictLocalNeighbourhoodProjection f s).app i))
            (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (Q.legs.app i))).inv.app K.obj)
